verdict.rationale: Airbyte's Connector Builder AI Assistant explicitly prefills and configures builder fields (auth, streams, pagination, etc.) from documentation, reducing manual connector setup, and the Connector Builder itself supports iterative review before shipping a connector — directly matching the story's core loop of AI-drafted, human-reviewed connectors. However, evidence is limited to first-party docs describing the feature qualitatively; there's no independent/hands-on account confirming end-to-end success on real-world API docs including complex auth/pagination edge cases. Missing for 10: independent verification of drafting accuracy on real APIs, detail on how auth/pagination are inferred vs. manually configured, and confirmation of full autonomy versus partial prefill requiring significant manual completion.
